remarks: Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this ultra-chic 2 bedroom, 2 full bathroom condo located in a private concierge building downtown Stamford. Enjoy the open floor plan, 10-11ft soaring ceilings, and large-pane oversized windows offering gorgeous panoramic sunset views overlooking the city. Hardwood Floors throughout, expansive rooms and the ultimate dream kitchen featuring custom white shaker style cabinets, quartz countertops and Wolf / Sub Zero appliances. Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with huge walk-in custom closet and spa inspired bathroom with double sink vanity, stall shower, and built-ins. Additional features include parking garage with two reserved spaces, fitness center, temperature controlled wine cellar and lounge/party room perfect for holiday hosting or weekend entertaining.
